arguments.command:
cd /workspace/scratch && sed -i "s/print('edges', len(req\['edges'\]), 'coms', len(req\['coms'\]), 'obs', sum(len(s\['observations'\]) for s in req\['snapshots'\]))/print('edges', len(req['edges']), 'coms', len(req['commodities']), 'obs', sum(len(s['observations']) for s in req['snapshots']))/" /dev/null; timeout 170 python3 -c "
import sys, random, time, json
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/scratch'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import gen_big, analyze
rng = random.Random(1)
req = gen_big.build(rng)
print('edges', len(req['edges']), 'coms', len(req['commodities']), 'obs', sum(len(s['observations']) for s in req['snapshots']))
inst = analyze._parse_request(req)
t0=time.time()
res = analyze.analyze(inst, req['id'])
t1=time.time()
print('time %.2f' % (t1-t0), res['status'], res['min_faults'])
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in res.items() if k in ('status','min_faults','faults')}))
"
